issue.title: Annotation sections for ref notes (`# Name` + `@name`)
issue.description: A Highlights sticky note whose first line is `# Name` declares a section, and every highlight, underline, image, or sticky note tagged `@name` renders grouped under it: real headings with a quiet section card in Obsidian, native section headers in the Bob Mac Capture Refs panel, and grouped output in every `bob ref show` format. Notes that never declare a section stay byte-identical, the grouping is re-derived from the annotations on every scan (nothing new is persisted), and adding, removing, or moving a tag never changes a `^h-` ID or re-creates a task.

DISCOVERED ISSUE (from bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5 lander, 2026-10-24): bob-cli master CI is red on both test jobs because of bd.1 commit 6ec2f16a (level-aware sidecar page headings). Failing nodes: tests/cli/highlights/continuations.rs::continuation_scan_tucks_two_pages_and_is_idempotent (line 218) and ::continuation_scan_reports_dangling_marker (line 313). CI run 40095684849 on 94591ea6: test (ubuntu-latest) and test (macos-latest) fail exactly these two (1992/2 and 1990/2); lint and package pass. Bisect on athena: cargo test --test cli highlights::continuations passes 3/3 at bff7bc72 (6ec2f16a^) and fails 2/3 at 6ec2f16a. Root cause: parse_sidecar_markdown now takes page_heading_level from the FIRST page-shaped heading. These fixtures start with a simple-style marker page '## Page 1' and then use linked '#### [Page 11](highlights://...)' headings, so level=2 and the #### page headings no longer split the stream; every highlight renders under '### Page 1', continuations=0, and the dangling line names Page 1. bd.1 validated only lib highlights_ref tests (631), not the CLI suite. Read-only vault scan: 0 of the live sidecars mix page-heading levels, so live impact is nil today, but the first-heading rule is fragile (a level-1 '# P values' sticky before the first real page heading would disable all page splits). The fix belongs to this epic (choose the level from linked-style or most-common page headings, or accept any level for linked [Page N](highlights://) headings), then rerun cargo test --test cli highlights::. Not caused by bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5; no task created because this active epic owns the causal commit.
